The balanceOf[_to] += _value; line can cause an integer overflow if _value is large and balanceOf[_to] + _value > balanceOf[_to]. The previousBalances variable is used to check if the transfer will cause an integer overflow. If it does, the transfer will not be executed.

The _transfer(msg.sender, _to, _value); line can cause an integer overflow if _value is large. The transfer function is called by msg.sender, and the _value is the amount of tokens to be transferred. If _value is large, this will cause an integer overflow.
